name: signet
description: Every Apple firmware, its signing status, downloads and device specs, from Apple's own servers (feeds, IPSW contents, gs.apple.com TSS, gdmf).

scripts.json: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --json --history signet-history.json > signet-report.json && echo 'Wrote signet-report.json (history: signet-history.json)'
scripts.site:dev: test -f signet-report.json || npm run json; hugo server -s site
